summary: Why a fast-lane task did not finish in one pass. Each rework event takes the first category whose hint (a case-insensitive regex) matches its text; no match is unclassified. A project replaces or adds a category, or overrides a setting, in .agentrof/rework-causes.json.
repeat_offender_rule: Test {test} failed in more than one task: fix its cause or quarantine it with an issue, and run it locally before pushing a change near it.

categories.description: a team plugin script or contract failed or refused wrongly
categories.rule: Record the plugin defect in the plugin ledger, patch the local copy and send the fix upstream.

categories.description: merge conflict or a branch behind its target
categories.rule: Keep parallel tasks on disjoint files, run overlap before writing and rebase on the target branch before open-pr.

categories.description: CI runner, network, service or resource failure
categories.rule: Pin and cache CI dependencies and images, and retry network setup inside the job instead of re-running the workflow.
Make the test independent of order, time and shared state, or quarantine it with an issue; never re-run CI to get green.

categories.description: the changed files were not mapped to their tests, so the right tests did not run before the push
categories.rule: Map every changed source file to its tests before open-pr; a change that selects no test is a mapping gap, not a pass.
Run the project's formatter and linter on the changed files before every push.
Run the type checker on the changed modules before every push.

categories.description: documentation gate: links, front matter or vault rules
categories.rule: Run the docs validation for the changed trees and fix links and front matter before open-pr.

categories.description: acceptance criteria missing, ambiguous or misread
categories.rule: Write each acceptance criterion with its expected value and its named test before writing code; ask the owner when a criterion has two readings.

categories.description: review found a behavior without a test
categories.rule: Add a test for each criterion and each new branch in the same change; the reviewer checks one per criterion.

categories.description: review found a defect the author missed
categories.rule: Before opening the PR, read the diff once against the reviewer's checklist (security, failure paths, data custody) and fix what it names.
Run the touched test modules locally before pushing and reproduce a red test before changing it.
